question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Propitious
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Inauspicious.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Propitious"** means favorable or advantageous, while inauspicious means unfavorable or unlucky. (अनुकूल; संभवतः सफल परिणाम उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** *It was a **propitious**__ time to start a new business.*
 
 
 
• The prefix** "in-" **in **inauspicious** is a negation, indicating the opposite meaning of the base word.
 
• **"Inauspicious"** means showing signs that the future will not be good or successful; unlucky. (जिसमें भविष्‍य के अनुकूल या सफल न होने के संकेत हों; अशुभ, अमांगलिक)
 __
 
• **Example: ***The weather forecast for the wedding day was **inauspicious**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Inauspicious"** is the opposite of **"propitious."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Auspicious** is a synonym for propitious, meaning favorable or promising.
 
• **Benign** means gentle or kind, but it is not an antonym of propitious.
 
• **Benignant** is an obsolete word that means kindly or gracious, but it is not an antonym of propitious.
